output.audience: players who want to play a single-player minesweeper puzzle
output.primary_goal: Let players clear a minefield by revealing safe cells and flagging mines, with a clear win or loss outcome.
output.scope_summary: A playable minesweeper game consisting of a grid board, mine placement, cell reveal and flag interaction, and win/loss detection with a game timer and mine counter.
model_focus: Board grid and cell states (hidden, revealed, flagged)
Game session state (in progress, won, lost) and elapsed time
Difficulty settings (grid size and mine count)
assumptions: The game is single-player and runs locally or in a browser without a backend.
Standard minesweeper rules apply, with the first reveal guaranteed safe unless the pitch specifies otherwise.
